h1: Custom Hanes Golf Tees for Your Tournament or Event
metaTitle: Custom Hanes Golf Tees | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Hanes golf tees for your next event. Great quality and comfort. Perfect for tournaments and corporate outings.
introHtml: Custom Hanes golf tees combine reliable comfort with the trusted Hanes brand. Perfect for corporate golf tournaments or employee appreciation events, these tees offer a soft, durable feel that holds up through a full day on the course. Choose from popular styles like the 6.1 oz Tagless T-Shirt or the ComfortSoft Cotton Tee, both ideal for screen printing your logo or event details. Custom Hanes golf tees ensure your brand looks great from the first tee to the 19th hole.
heroAltText: Custom Hanes golf tees with printed logo, displayed on a golfer at a tournament.
